description.zh: 活动编码,可使用系统编码，也可修改系统编码使用自定义编码
description.en: The activity code. You can use a system code or modify the system code to use a custom code.

description.zh: 动作记录扩展字段，如：{"处理类型":"退费","赔偿金额":"12","处理内容":"已妥善处理","处理时间":"2020-09-21"}'
description.en: The extended field for the action record, such as {"ProcessType":"Refund","CompensationAmount":"12","ProcessContent":"Properly handled","ProcessTime":"2020-09-21"}.

description.zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
description.en: The unique client request ID for idempotence verification. You can use a UUID.

description.zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
description.en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service instance. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console.
